title: MINOR: Bump Jackson version to 2.21.8
body:
Based on the discussion in
https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/23862#issuecomment-6305190312, this
PR upgrades Jackson from 2.21.7 to 2.21.8 on the 4.4 branch. It also
updates the corresponding entries in `LICENSE-binary`.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

files.patch:
@@ -214,15 +214,15 @@ License Version 2.0:
 - commons-validator-1.10.1
 - hash4j-0.22.0
 - jackson-annotations-2.21
-- jackson-core-2.21.7
-- jackson-databind-2.21.7
-- jackson-dataformat-csv-2.21.7
-- jackson-dataformat-yaml-2.21.7
-- jackson-datatype-jdk8-2.21.7
-- jackson-jakarta-rs-base-2.21.7
-- jackson-jakarta-rs-json-provider-2.21.7
-- jackson-module-blackbird-2.21.7
-- jackson-module-jakarta-xmlbind-annotations-2.21.7
+- jackson-core-2.21.8
+- jackson-databind-2.21.8
+- jackson-dataformat-csv-2.21.8
+- jackson-dataformat-yaml-2.21.8
+- jackson-datatype-jdk8-2.21.8
+- jackson-jakarta-rs-base-2.21.8
+- jackson-jakarta-rs-json-provider-2.21.8
+- jackson-module-blackbird-2.21.8
+- jackson-module-jakarta-xmlbind-annotations-2.21.8
 - jakarta.inject-api-2.0.1
 - jakarta.validation-api-3.0.2
 - javassist-3.30.2-GA

@@ -62,7 +62,7 @@ versions += [
   gradle: "9.6.1",
   grgit: "5.3.3",
   httpclient: "4.5.14",
-  jackson: "2.21.7",
+  jackson: "2.21.8",
   jacksonAnnotations: "2.21",
   jacoco: "0.8.14",
   javassist: "3.30.2-GA",
